items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29

items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: he also was a good friend of Frank Pena because Frank used to, if he didn't call me, he would call Randy

ctx.x: Anything else from his column strike you?

Well, there are many things that strike me when I start thinking about my classmate from Hawthorne High School, Randy the Whip, who was one of the first disc jockeys in the city of New Orleans. He was really a mechanic by trade. He had a mechanical mind. And he taught school at a big building on the corner of Jackson Avenue and doing Chapitula Street for many years. And then he left there and he became a disc jockey and started doing broadcasting on the radio. And he also was a good friend of Frank Pena because…
